title: Black Olive Tapenade with Capers, Anchovy and Thyme
summary: Garlic, anchovies and capers are pulsed fine, then Kalamata olives and thyme are added and olive oil and lemon worked in to a slightly chunky paste.
equipment: food processor or pestle and mortar

ingredients.item: pitted Kalamata olives, rinsed and drained
small baguette (about 200 g), sliced and toasted, to serve

steps.title: Make the base
steps.text: Pulse the garlic in a food processor until finely chopped. Add the anchovies and capers and pulse until finely ground, scraping down.

steps.title: Add the olives
steps.text: Add the olives and thyme and pulse to a slightly chunky paste.

steps.title: Add the oil
steps.text: With the motor running, add the lemon juice and then the oil in a thin stream. Season with pepper; no salt is needed.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast the baguette slices in a 200 °C (180 °C fan) oven for 6-8 minutes until crisp.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the tapenade at room temperature with the toasts.

tips: Rinse the olives and capers to keep the salt in check.
Keep a little texture; a completely smooth paste loses character.
A spoonful also lifts pasta, roast chicken or grilled fish.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge, with a thin layer of oil on top, for up to 1 week. Bring to room temperature before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
